runner.instructions: Each 'run' entry MUST be executed as a separate 'claude --bare' subprocess. All runs MUST be launched in parallel (not sequentially). Each subprocess uses the flags specified in the run config. Never run evals from different run groups in the same session.
runner.prompt_rules: The subprocess prompt MUST contain ONLY: (1) the skill path to load, and (2) the eval's 'prompt' field verbatim. Do NOT include expected_output, expectations, eval metadata, hints about correct behavior, or any framing like 'you are being tested'. The subprocess must behave exactly as it would for a real user. The expected_output and expectations fields are for GRADING ONLY — they must never appear in or influence the subprocess prompt.

runs.description: All evals: standard environment with web access for package registry lookups

evals.prompt:
Fix this OSH finding. Sigrid customer: test-corp, system: backend-api. Mode: autonomous.

Finding: pkg:pypi/requests@2.28.0 — CVE-2023-32681 (HIGH). Vulnerability in requests package allowing unintended leak of Proxy-Authorization header to destination servers during HTTPS redirects.
evals.expected_output: Skill routes to MR path, spawns researcher with CVE context, attempts version bump and Sigrid CI verification, then attempts to create a branch and MR.
expectations: Decides to route to MR path (not Issue) — vulnerability fix is a version bump candidate
Spawns osh-researcher subagent with CVE-2023-32681 and the current version (2.28.0) as context
Attempts to invoke Sigrid CI verification (sigrid-ci-feedback skill) before creating the artifact
Attempts to create a branch with a name matching the pattern fix/osh-* (e.g. fix/osh-requests)
Produces or attempts to produce a persistent artifact (MR or issue) — does NOT degrade to informal text output or verbal recommendation

evals.prompt:
Fix these OSH findings. Sigrid customer: test-corp, system: api-gateway. Mode: autonomous.

Findings for pkg:maven/com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-databind@2.9.8:
1. CVE-2019-14540 (CRITICAL) — polymorphic deserialization via HikariConfig
2. CVE-2019-16335 (CRITICAL) — polymorphic deserialization via FileNameMap
3. CVE-2020-36518 (HIGH) — deeply nested JSON causes DoS via stack overflow

Current version is 2.9.8, project uses Java 8.
evals.expected_output: Skill groups all 3 CVEs as one fix unit, spawns ONE researcher call with all CVE IDs + Java 8 constraint, then routes to MR or Issue depending on whether a single version satisfies all.
expectations: Groups all 3 CVEs as a single fix unit for one component — does NOT spawn 3 separate researcher calls
Spawns researcher with ALL 3 CVE IDs (CVE-2019-14540, CVE-2019-16335, CVE-2020-36518) included in the context
Researcher is given the Java 8 compatibility constraint so it can filter out versions requiring Java 11+
Either routes to MR (single version satisfies all 3 CVEs) OR routes to Issue (explains why no single version works) — does NOT attempt partial fixes
Produces or attempts to produce a persistent artifact (MR or issue)

Spawns researcher with context about current version (2.2.28), latest (5.1.3), and that 2.2.x is end-of-life

Produces or attempts to produce a persistent artifact (MR or issue)

evals.prompt:

Finding: pkg:npm/jsonwebtoken@8.5.1 — CVE-2022-23529 (HIGH). Insecure implementation of key retrieval function allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a crafted JWK.

Multiple patched versions available: 9.0.0 (major bump, breaking changes to API), 8.5.2 (if it exists — patch-level fix).
evals.expected_output: In interactive mode, the skill should ask the user which version to target rather than auto-selecting. It should present the tradeoff between patch safety and major-bump completeness.
expectations: Operates in interactive mode — asks the user to confirm or select the target version rather than auto-picking
Presents the version options with tradeoff context (patch = safer but may not exist, major = complete fix but breaking changes)
Does NOT auto-select a version in interactive mode — the skill's mode table says 'Ask which version' for interactive
Spawns researcher with CVE-2022-23529 and current version 8.5.1 to find actual available patched versions
Waits for user input at the version selection decision point before proceeding to implementation
